title: New public grafana-ui component requires barrel export + colocated .story.tsx
answers: What files must I touch when adding a new component to grafana-ui?
Why is my new component not visible outside the package?
What's the story file naming convention?
body: 1) Add the export to `packages/grafana-ui/src/index.ts` — nothing else makes it public (no api-extractor gate). 2) Add a colocated `Component.story.tsx` next to `Component.tsx` — this is the enforced convention (135 files follow it); `.stories.tsx` is never used in this package. Story titles are lint-enforced by `@grafana/consistent-story-titles` configured in `eslint.config.js:298-303` against `packages/grafana-ui/src/**/*.story.tsx`.
applies: Applies to new components intended to be part of the public @grafana/ui API. Internal-only helpers under src/internal/ don't need the barrel export.
